collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — NATURE, ECOLOGY AND ANIMALS (NAT-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Isola's animals, plants, tides and weather: tide pools and nesting beaches, washed-up rubbish, shrinking clam beds, strange visitors, creatures doing what creatures do, and choices about the island where nobody gets a perfect answer.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks a child aged 3-10 and another villager)

collection.description: A small child's drawing twig walked off their hand: find it again, or tell everyone about the walking twig.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) picked up a twig to draw in the sand with, and the twig walked off (subject.his/her) hand. (subject.He/she) is now standing frozen, pointing at a bush, unable to say anything except "It walked. It WALKED." (friend) comes over to look. On the bush, among the twigs, one twig has very thin legs.

choices.label: Tell Everyone About the Walking Twig

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (friend) and (subject) spend ages searching the bush. Every twig looks like a twig. (subject) gets more and more frustrated. Then (friend) points very slowly: there it is, swaying gently, pretending to be blown by the wind. (subject) is so impressed (subject.he/she) can hardly breathe. (subject.He/she) spends the rest of the day pointing at twigs and asking, "Is THAT one an animal?" Most of them aren't.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) tells everybody. Nobody believes (subject.him/her). (subject) leads a group of disbelieving grown-ups back to the bush. They can't find it. (subject) is furious. Then a leaf on a different branch opens its wings and turns out to be a moth. The grown-ups go quiet. They start looking at every bush a little more carefully on the way home.
